Mice in the positive control group were injected with 300 mgmiddotkg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> of BrdU on the fetation-day-9 and fetation-day-10 days. On fetation-day-11, the embryos were taken out by cesarean section. The expressions of Gli3 Shh and Fgf4 were detected by Whole-mount in situ hybridization. This subject was supported by National Natural Science Fund (No. 60471032). Morphological analysis indicated that the polydactylia rate of the EMP radiation group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05). And it was also indicated that limb abnormality often occurred to the hindlimbs. In embryo limbs (fetation-day-11) of the EMP radiation group and the positive control group, the ectopic expression of Fgf4 was detected in AER; the overexpression and ectopic expression of Shh were detected in the ZPA; the decreased expression of Gli3 was detected in mesenchyme cells. The occurrence of polydactylia in mice increased after EMP radiation and it may have some relationship with the abnormal expressions of the above-mentioned genes

articleTitle: A design of PMMW camera for security scanning
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: From the request of the Customs house for detecting things hidden in the clothes, base on the specific characteristics of the different technical scheme on PMMW imaging system, an imaging scheme that uses broad-band multi-beam antenna in one dimension and machine scanning in another dimension has been selected. The experimental system has been designed and some examination has been done. The result shown the experimental system can be used for security scanning in the Customs house

articleTitle: A New Method to Design Matching Networks for Multistage Microwave Amplifiers
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A new method to design matching networks for multistage microwave amplifiers in a prescribed frequency band with requirements about the transducer gain flatness is presented. A topology of matching network is obtained firstly according to the criteria of minimum network Q values in the centre frequency. Then the transducer gain function is got using the harmonic balance. And the best transducer gain can be obtained by optimizing the matching networks

articleTitle: Field Properties of Conductive Rectangular Plates in an External Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The field properties of plane rectangular plates placed in external low-frequency magnetic fields are investigated by solving a plane eddy current problem with a quasi-analytical approach. A hybrid boundary integral equation for the magnetic vector potential inside the plates is derived from Maxwell's equations and is solved analytically for plates with different geometrical and material properties

articleTitle: Simulation of Broad-band Radar Target Echo Based on Electromagnetic Scattering Computing
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A new method for simulation of step frequency radar target echo based on electromagnetic scattering computing is presented at this paper. With modeling and segmenting of target, the target echo simulation is carried out. Meanwhile the different position in target echo is sampled and the range profiles are achieved by IFFT filter. It is found that the different information of target in different position of echo could be simulated by this way

articleTitle: An Efficient and Automated Method for Electromagnetic Compatibility Analysis along Congested Right-of-Way
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Electromagnetic interference caused by electric power lines can cause serious damage to nearby utilities and may pose safety hazards to the public. The computation of interference effects along a long and congested right-of-way is a complex and time-consuming procedure. This paper discusses recent advances in techniques developed to automate EMC analysis. With these advanced techniques and automation, all relevant parameters used for representing a right-of-way (such as soil resistivity, line characteristics, right-of-way configurations, etc.) can be modeled accurately. The maximum interference levels due to both the inductive and conductive components are automatically determined under steady-state and fault conditions at all specified locations

articleTitle: Measurement simulation Relaxation TN Medium Twisted For Liquid Crystal Display
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The result is shown to contain the gauge-fixed action of the bosonic string in conformal gauge as a special case. The dynamical critical exponent z of the Ising antiferromagnet under the constraint of a fixed zero magnetization is verified by Monte Carlo simulations to be compatible with that of the usual Glauber dynamics of model A, while for positive magnetization the exponent seems different. We also determine the diffusivity of the magnetization and finite size effects. A Stern-Gerlach type experiment is presented as an unsharp joint measurement of spin components. Using a simple realistic magnetic field, the interaction Hamiltonian reads H = mu(-sigma(x)x + sigma(z)z)

articleTitle: Translation of the Electromagnetic Mode-Splitting along a Microstrip Line with a Slit in the Ground Plane
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Is proposed an approach to know magnitudes of parasitic electromagnetic modes excited by the micro-strip line passing over a slit in the return plane. A part of the power having been carried along the microstrip-line is transferred to the coplanar-line modes along the slot, and the cylindrical mode in between the pair of return and ground planes. Magnitudes of those modes are expressed by the ratio of powers of the excited electromagnetic mode to the original microstrip line mode, discarding information of phase. Calculation was done with FDTD in the limited domain around the cross-point in a moderate time of calculation. This approach contributes to the efficient designing of PCB of commercial electronic devices

articleTitle: Re-examine the Limitation of the Complex Poynting Theorem
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The limitation of the complex Poynting theorem (CPT) has already been mentioned in many literatures. But its origin is not discovered yet. The authors find that the limitation originates from the fact that the complex Poynting theorem is derived from a necessary but insufficient condition. It is this insufficiency that makes the theorem correct mathematically but defective intrinsically. Two forms of the CPT, field as well as circuit, are analyzed

articleTitle: Effects of Pulsed Electromagnetic Waves(PEMW) Exposure on The Function of The Pituitary-Adrenocortical Axis of Rats
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The effects of PEMW (pulsed electromagnetic waves) exposure on the function of the pituitary-adrenocortical axis of the rats are explored. Radioimmunoassay (RIA) was performed to observe the changes of contents of ACTH (adrenocorticotropic hormone), COR (cortisone) and ALD (aldosterone) in the sera of the rats. The ACTH level in serum decreased at first and reached the lowest point at 12h after exposure(P<0.05), and then recovered. COR decreased gradually following irradiation and reached the lowest point at 24h after exposure (P<0.01), and then recovered. ALD decreased gradually following irradiation and reached the lowest point at 24h(P<0.01), and then recovered at 48h but increased significantly on 7d after exposure(P<0.01). PEMW disturbance of ACTH, COR and ALD in the sera of rats and the effect appeared at early stage, and lasted a certain duration. It is inferred that PEMW could have certain effects on the function of the pituitary-adrenocortical axis of the rats

articleTitle: Decision of combined and transforming lines shielding under lightning strokes
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Modern lines of communications can include lines of different types: symmetrical, coaxial, fibre etc, even they have a short length. Moreover, in modern communication lines IP- telephony and packet switching are widely applied. Different parts of the same document can be passed on different lines in different moments of time. Thus, probability of lightning damage of such compound and virtual channels is not constant during the different moments of time. Some aspects of this problem are touched in this article

articleTitle: Simple Expressions for External Wire Impedance and Admittance for Lightning Current Pulse Propagation in Buried Wires
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Lightning surge propagation in buried cables and grounding systems is a subject of practical interest. In this paper we present simple expressions for external wire impedance and admittance that are valid for studying the lightning interaction with buried wires based on transmission line analysis. Buried wires can be either bare (counterpoise) or insulated (cables). Due to certain drawbacks of existing ground impedance expressions, a modified empirical ground impedance expression for buried wires is proposed. As it's well known that lightning transients have frequencies between few kHz to few MHz, the ground impedance and ground admittance behavior is investigated for wide frequency range

articleTitle: Absorbing Effectiveness Simulation and Measurement of Double-Layer Wave Absorbers in Ku-Band
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A simulation method on absorbing effectiveness (AE) has been presented in this paper. Double-layer AE formulas have been proposed for simulating calculation in Ku-band. Two wave absorbers composed of chloridized polyethylene (CPE) -based composites with nickel powders and ZnO whiskers were prepared and investigated in detail. Absorbing mechanisms on the double-layer with inducted layer and magnetic loss layer was discussed and evaluated by simulation and measurement. Experiments indicate that theoretical calculation on AE values conforms to measured AE values. By this simulation method, the optimization of wave absorbers can be realized.

articleTitle: Effects of EMP exposure on mice lymphocytes
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The bioeffects of EMP exposure on mice lymphocytes are observed. Mice were whole-body exposed to different field intensity of EMP (0, 50, 100, 200 and 400 kV/m) for 200 pulses. The effects of EMP exposure on mice lymphocytes proliferation were studied by <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H-thymidine ( <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H-TdR) incorporation. Cell cycle was evaluated by flow cytometry (FCM). The ultrastructure of mice lymphocytes was observed by transmission electron microscope (TEM). HPRT gene mutation of mice peripheral blood lymphocytes were investigated by lymphocyte cloning assay. The proliferation index of T lymphocytes increased after exposure to 100 kV/m and 200 kV/m EMP. The proliferation index of B lymphocytes were decreased after exposure to 400 kV/m EMP. EMP exposure led the ultrastructure alteration of mice lymphocytes and influenced the cell cycle progression of mice lymphocytes. HPRT gene mutant frequency of mice peripheral blood lymphocytes in 400 kV/m EMP exposure group is significantly increased. EMP exposure put some effects on the proliferation, cell cycle progression and ultrastructure of mice lymphocytes. Followed EMP exposure, HPRT gene mutant frequency were increased in a field intensity-dependent way

articleTitle: Investigation and Development of a Time-Domain Chamber for Antenna and RCS Measurement
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Principles of time-domain measurement in chamber was studied. Developing procedures of a test system for antenna and RCS were introduced. sampling oscilloscope was used for measuring in compact range chamber for the first time. Idea of virtual instrument was used. Finally, curves achieved from the system were offered

articleTitle: Evaluation of Transmit Antenna Position in Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The calibration of the reverberation chamber is very important. The influence of the position of the transmit antenna on the performance of the reverberation chamber is analyzed according to the measurement data. The parameters such as field uniformity, quality factor and the receiver antenna calibration factor are analyzed in detail on the different positions of the transmit antenna. It reveals that the position of the transmit antenna has insignificant influence on the testing repeatability and the orientation of the transmit antenna aligning to the stirrer is a better way for calibration and testing

articleTitle: ESD Generator Analyzed by Transmission Line Theory
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, the transmission line theory was used to analyze the electrostatic discharge (ESD) transient process. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is used to simulate the discharge current being prescribed in the IEC 61000-4-2. The factors influencing the current parameters were examined, the suggestion for designing ESD generator was put forward

articleTitle: Combination of Flux Shunting and Flux Displacing in the Magnetic Shielding
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper presents the study of two phenomena in magnetic field shielding, "flux shunting" when the ferromagnetic materials direct magnetic fluxes into themselves and "flux displacing", when the magnetic fluxes are shifted to the surface of the shielding materials. These two phenomena influence on the shielding effectiveness of shielding material. It can be stated that the flux shunting phenomenon dominates at lower frequency and flux displacing phenomenon at higher frequency

articleTitle: Influence of the grounding Electrode on transient grounding resistance under pulsed discharging current
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The influence of the variations of grounding electrode in volume, surface area, conductivity and permeability on transient grounding resistance (TGR) under pulsed discharging current is analyzed with FDTD method in this paper. From the computation results, some useful conclusion can be got as follow: the grounding electrodes with the same surface area have nearly the same TGR. For the grounding electrodes with the same volume, the larger the surface area is, the smaller is the TGR. Nonmetal grounding electrode, whose conductivity is high enough, has the same discharging effect as the metal. The permeability of grounding electrode has little influence on TGR

articleTitle: Computing the Radiation Patterns of Monopoles Installed on Large Structures by Using MLFMA
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The EFIE combined with the MLFMA is applied to analyze the radiation properties of wire antennas mounted on complex conducting platforms to realize fast, accurate solutions. Wire, surface and junction basis functions are used to model the current distribution on the object. The application of MLFMA reduces memory requirement and computing time compared to MOM, especially for the antenna on a large-sized platform. GMRES with ILUT preconditioner is applied to reduce the iterative number. Several typical numerical examples are present to show the versatility, accuracy and the efficiency of this method

articleTitle: Effects of electromagnetic pulse on the activity of protein kinase of rat myocardium
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The effects of electromagnetic pulse (EMP) are investigated on the activity of protein kinase A (PKA) and protein kinase C (PKC) of rat myocardium in cellular signal transduction. EMP generator (40 kVmiddotm-1, 50 pulses, interphase at 2 min) was used to expose the SD rats to EMP. Radiotracing method was used to determine the activity of protein kinase C and protein kinase A in myocardial tissues. At 12h after the exposure, compared with normal control group, myocardial cytoplasm PKA activity of the EMP group was found to have significantly increased (P<0.01 ) whereas membrane PKA activity decreased significantly (P<0.01) and the total myocardial PKA activity dropped by 9.7%; myocardial cytoplasm PKC activity dropped (P<0.01) whereas membrane PKC activity rose significantly ( P<0.01 ) and the total myocardial PKC activity rose by 11.34%. On one hand, NEMP can reduce myocardial cytoplasm PKC activity but increase myocardial cytoplasm PKA. On the other hand, NEMP can increase membrane PKC activity but reduce membrane PKA activity. The results above suggest that NEMP can affect cellular signal transduction on the level of protein kinase

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Diagnostic of Arctic Cryolitozone by Radiowave Methods
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a detailed physical description and classification of electrical properties, construction and structure of the cryolitozone at the depth of skin-layer in VLF range for Aldan plateau, central part of the Yakutia and tundra regions not far from the Arctic Ocean. Electrical characteristics of the regions studied are typical for the cryolitozone. A frequency dispersion of some types of permafrost zones is experimentally studied. It is then shown that frequency dispersion of the electric resistance of the layer of frozen friable sediments over the frequency from direct current to VLF-MF ranges is a peculiarity of electrical properties of the cryolitozone. A complex interpretation of the data of radioimpedance and electric soundings for permafrost rocks is carried out on the basis of developed automated numerical methods of direct and inverse problems for the radioimpedance sounding. It is determined that geoelectrical sections with the type of K (rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> < rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> > rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) and the type of Q (rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> > rho <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> > rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) are most typical for sediment rocks of the cryolitozone at the depth of 100 meters of the Northern-East part of Russia. Geoelectrical section A (rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> < rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2 </sub> < rho<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) is the basic for ancient crystal rocks of the Aldan shield. Electrical properties of the cryolitozone are changed appropriately in space and in time and depend on the complex of the crystal and sediment rocks. The surface impedance shows inductive and capacitive nature and is changed in a wide range from minimum for saline lands to maximum for granitoids

articleTitle: Field Uniformity Calibration of Practical Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper describes the process of field uniformity calibration of the practical reverberation chamber which has been built in China Academy of Electronics and Information Technology (CAEIT). According to the IEC 61000-4-21 standard, the data which is obtained from the calibration is processed and compared with the IEC standard. In consequence, the advantage that high radiant electric field strength can be generated easily by low input power of reverberation chamber technique is proved through the course

articleTitle: Analysis of HBM-ESD current rise time and its deciding factors
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Circuit model of ESD test circumstance is established. By inverse Laplace transform, analytical expression of current is got. Then we obtain simulation of current rise time (t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>) under different combination of circuit parameters. A few fitted polynomials that describe the relationship of t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> to these parameters are got, whose accuracy is also analyzed

articleTitle: The Study on Sensitive Port of Silicon transistors Caused by ESD
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper deals with a sensitive ports study on typical silicon transistors caused by human body model (HBM) electrostatic discharge (ESD). It is shown that the most sensitive port is not always the EB junctions, as most scholars have stated

articleTitle: Study of a Cross-Feed Wide-band Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A novel cross-feed wide-band patch antenna is presented in this paper. Wide dipole is capacitively-loaded to realize a wide-band antenna element and two elements are cross-fed by parallel broadbrimmed coupled lines to actualize impedance match and enhance gain. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the antenna fabricated on a epsiv<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>=2.6 permittivity substrate of h=1 mm thickness can achieve 53% impedance bandwidth (VSWR < 2.0) and maximal gain reaches 4.8 dBi, with perfect far-field radiant characteristics and stable phase center. The antenna is easy to design and fabricate and it has a wide application

articleTitle: A Modified Liao's Absorbing Boundary Condition with stabilization
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A modified Liao's second-order absorbing boundary condition (ABC) is presented in this paper. With the modification, the proposed Liao's ABC can be stabilized even after several ten thousand time steps. This is useful in finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations for a significant period of time. Numerical examples show the effectiveness of the introduced ABC

articleTitle: Research on the Way of Evaluation and Test of Stochastic Pulse
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The author has done some research on these issues brought forward in the introduction and given her original opinion by the way of theoretical analysis and experimental validation. There are two great innovative points in this paper. The first one is that the author has used the signal of IS 95 mobile communication system to simulate the stochastic pulses which makes the experiment designed in this paper become feasible. The other one is that the author has given an original way that can be used to rightly and effectively test and evaluate the stochastic EMI by the way of designing FER measuring experiment on CDMA2000 system interfered by AWGN and stochastic pulses and by the way of analyzing and summarizing the experimental result.

articleTitle: First Rigorous Results of Mean Received Power in 2-Dimensional Mobile Radio Channels Using Theory of Stochastic Rays
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Random lattice channels are constructed based on the site percolation theory. By using stochastic ray theory and probability theory, the power distribution properties in random lattice channels are investigated. With appropriate analysis of the properties of random lattice channels, the site-specific probability of stochastic rays after undergone several reflections is obtained. The formulae used for calculating mean received power are obtained by rigorous mathematical deduction

articleTitle: Edge Diffraction Computing Based on SCTE
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The RCS calculation for high frequency large dimension complex targets in SCTE is divided into two parts: facet and edge. Reflection at conducting surfaces can be computed by using PO approximation. When it comes to identify the edges and calculate the edge diffraction, we obtain the edge parameters judging all edges of 2-dimension models presented in the screen which have been sheltered. Diffraction at edges is computed by MEC and PTD. The calculating results of typical targets are consistent with related references and experiment results. It indicates that the judgment method of target edges and obtaining method of edge parameters are feasible

articleTitle: Study on Backscattering Enhancement Effect from the Fractal Dielectric Rough Surface
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The paper is focused on the matched relationship between g and L for the electromagnetic scattering from the fractal rough surface by moment of method associated with the tapered incident wave. The valid matched relations are obtained at different incidences, which revise the conclusions given by Tsang and Ye et al. The modification of the shadowing function is considered at low grazing angles firstly. The results show that the shadowing function can reduce the surface length needed and improve the efficiency evidently

articleTitle: Propagation of Pulse Noise in Shipboard Electical Cables with Nonuniform Parameters
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Nanosecond pulses are generated in electrical system in commutation processes. Pulses can lead to malfunction of electronic equipment. Amplitude and duration of pulses on the equipment depend on propagation in power cables. The change of cable height above the ground leads to the change of wave impedance for common mode propagation. Ends of cables have the part with higher wave impedance. Calculation of pulse propagation in the cable line with nonuniform parameters is given in the paper

articleTitle: Analysis of Numerical Integration Accuracy of Singular Integrals in Moment Method of TDEFIE
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The area coordinates, relative coordinates, domain decomposition and general Duffy coordinate transformations are employed to transform the singular integrals (the supports of the basis and test functions have common facet, common edge or common one vertex) of the time-domain electric field integral equation (TDEFIE) into non-singular integrals, which allows to be accurately evaluated. With different temporal basis function (continuous and non-continuous derivative) and different time step size, the comparisons of the accuracy of the proposed method and traditional numerical integral methods are also presented

articleTitle: GPR Zone of Influence of a Modern Electric Power Network
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, the GPR zone of influence is analyzed for a typical real case scenario. The overhead and underground portions of the electric network around the 230 kV substation including transmission lines, distributions lines and the underground pipe network of a nearby town have been modeled. The total extent of the grounding network exceeds 10 miles. The zone of influence has been analyzed for different fault locations. It is demonstrated that the borders of the zone of influence represent a very complicated pattern even for this relatively simple scenario and that this pattern changes tremendously depending on the fault location. The computation method used in the analysis is based on the electromagnetic field theory approach

articleTitle: The Analysis and Restrain of the Electromagnetic Interferences in Power System Based on Wavelet Theory
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper analyses the main characteristics of transient electromagnetic environment in power system with wavelet theory. Combining with the accomplished actual project, the transient data of secondary system of a certain power plant is mentioned to be analyzed and processed as a concrete application of the wavelet theory. Good results are obtained in both the separation of the signal and noise by using the method of wavelet analysis and the detection of the singular points of the signal by choosing proper wavelet bases. The statistical analysis to the result is also discussed

articleTitle: An Unconditionally Stable Scheme using R-FDTD for the Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: An unconditionally stable numerical method combined with R-FDTD for the scattering problems is proposed. The marching-on in time method as in the FDTD scheme is replaced by a marching-on in order method based on weighted Laguerre polynomials. The divergence relationship is also used in the proposed method, which leads to a more memory efficient formulation. To verify the accuracy and the efficiency of the proposed method, we compare the results of the conventional FDTD method with the proposed method

articleTitle: Effects of DiLong oblatum on free radical oxidative injury after EMP radiation
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The preventive and therapeutic effects of DiLong oblatum are observed on free radical oxidative injury in mouse brain and testis after EMP radiation. Activity of SOD was detected by NBT method and content of MDA was detected by TBA method. Compared with control group, activity of SOD in brain and testis decreased significantly and content of MDA in brain and testis increased significantly after EMP radiation. The activity of SOD in brain and testis increased significantly and content of MDA in brain and testis decreased significantly if DiLong oblatum was administered to mouse before EMP radiation. The activity of SOD in brain increased significantly and content of MDA in brain decreased significantly if DiLong oblatum was administered to mouse after EMP radiation. DiLong oblatum had some preventive and therapeutic effects on free radical oxidative injury in mouse brain after EMP radiation. DiLong oblatum had some preventive effects on free radical oxidative injury in mouse testis after EMP radiation

articleTitle: The Study of Active Periodical Structure's Absorbing the incident wave
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Structural absorb is present in this paper. Using the periodical surface's character of band gap and impedance transition of electromagnetic crystal structure such as PBG and HIS, put the varactor diode onto the approximate HIS to join cells on top layer to realize the electronic control for periodical structure, will establish the active periodical structure. The simulation test prove that this method and technology could absorb vertical incident wave 4-14 dB on working frequency band by using single or double layer active periodical structure, and the working frequency band could be changed and controlled by electronic method also

articleTitle: Shielding Factor Calculation of Mixed Power-lines with The Over-head Transmission Line, Transformer & Cable
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, presented is a shielding factor calculation method of mixed power lines with the over-head transmission line, transformer and cable in urban districts. If the power transformer type is Y0/Y0, the transformer secondary coil circuit is coupled with its primary coil circuit through not only the magnetic steel core but also its ground resistance. An uncoupled algorithm of its ground resistance is proposed. Some example results show that this method is valid and realistic

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Environmental Survey & Analysis for Railway Systems
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper presents RF data measurements and analysis between Incheon and Kimpo Airports in Korea, above ground level, total distance of approximately 31 km, and 2 km apart between each measurement point

articleTitle: Effects of Serum Immune Globulin Induced by Pulsed Electromagnetic Wave on Rats
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Objective: To investigate the effect of PEMW on humoral immunity and provide theoretical basis for formulating the standard of PEMW injury and protection. Methods: We set three groups of rats to receive whole body exposure by using 100, 103 and 104 times pulse electromagnetic wave(PEMW) respectively, whose field intensity is 100kV/m of each, then anesthetized the rats at different time after the exposure, gathered blood and separated the serum.. Immunization nephelometry was used to determine the content of IgA, IgG, IgM in serum. Results: The content of IgA, IgG, IgM in serum began to decrease at 12h after 104 times PEMW exposure, especially that of IgM and IgG decreased significantly (p<0.05, p<0.01). The content did not recover until 8d after the exposure. The content of IgA obviously decreased (p<0.05) at 48h after 103 times pulses exposure. But IgG level increased significantly (p<0.01) at 48h after exposure. And there was no statistical difference of IgM. . Conclusion: PEMW exposure can depress of serum immune globulin of rat. IgM is the most sensitive one to exposure. And 103 times pulses may be one effect window.

articleTitle: Calibration of Acceleration-meter in Correlation Study of Approach Speed with Intensity of ESD
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Analysis of correlation between approach speed and intensity of ESD relies on accuracy and reliability of speed data measurement. A calibration method has been used for an acceleration-meter, which can provide basic data for correlation study of approach speed with parameters of electrostatic discharge from human-body charged

articleTitle: A Study on Pulse Propagation on Double Side PCB
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper clarifies the differential mode pulse propagation characteristics on the parallel plates consisting of DC power supply plane and its return plane, from the viewpoint of series resonance of parallel plates, experimentally and by PSPICE simulation. It is concluded that the practical pulse propagation characteristics are dominated by the characteristics of not only the parallel plates but also the wirings connected to the parallel plates

articleTitle: Measurement of Pulsed Magnetic Field Shielding Effect of Reinforced Grids Cubic Cages
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper presents measurements of shielding effectiveness of reinforced grids cubic cages to pulsed magnetic field. Under the environment of pulsed magnetic fields, the shielding effectiveness of some typical size of the reinforced grids cages were obtained. Two connecting methods for the cross points (welding or banding) of the reinforcement mesh are evaluated. For discussing the pulsed magnetic fields shielding effectiveness, some shielding cell models are established, which are composed with size of mesh or connecting form of the cross points

articleTitle: Study of the ultrastructural changes in the thyroid gland of rats exposed to pulsed electromagnetic wave(PEMW)
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The effects of exposure to PEMW (pulsed electromagnetic wave) on function and morphology of the thyroid gland of rats are observed. At different time points (24 h, 48 h, 96 h, 8 d) after exposure to PEMW (E = 115 kVmiddotm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, 12000 pulses), radioimmuno-assay was performed to observe the levels of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), thyroxine (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) and triiodothyronine (T3) in sera of those male SD rats; the optics microscope and the transmission electron microscope were used to observe the structural changes of thyroid gland as the indicated time points respectively. The T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4 </sub> and TSH in sera all increased significantly to the peak at 24 h, then gradually decreased. Although there were no obvious changes under the optics microscope, some ultrastructural changes had been found under the transmission electron microscope in thyroid gland. Ultrastructures were obviously changed at 12 h and aggravated after 12 h until 48 h. In these rats, dilatated endoplasmic reticulum gathered with lots of protein excretion, lipid droplet and the heterochromatin gathered under the nucleus membranes were observed in follicular epithelial cells. These changes were palliated at 96 h but not recovered. PEMW can affect levels of hormones in sera and the hazard ultrastructural changes of thyroid gland. Endoplasmic reticulum is the main injured organelle

articleTitle: Designing Radio-frequency Electromagnetic Field Immunity of Watt-hour Meter Test System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: According to IEC 61000-4-3, a new method using LabVIEW to build radio-frequency electromagnetic field immunity of Watt-hour meter test system is researched in this paper. The test interface, flow diagram and key technologies are to be analyzed. With the expansibility of LabVIEW program, this system is applicable to adjust its parameters or programs for different test requirements

articleTitle: NiosII Soft-Core Processor Implementation in the Moving Controlling System of ESD Pole
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In dealing with the frequently happened problem of partially failure in the common VLSI chips under strong EMI environment, a method of the hardening of the logic core for the controlling system is offered based on NiosII soft-core technology. This method both improved fundamentally the normal used protecting methods for the traditional control systems, and structurally enhanced the reliability of the control system under ESD environment

articleTitle: Wave Propagation Characteristics of Cylindrical Waveguide Filled with Time-varying Media
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Separation of variables method is used and the field expression of both the cylindrical waveguide and the coaxial-line are obtained in the time-varying media. It is clearly shown that both the amplitude and frequency of the waves change with time in time-varying media. The phase constant and the phase velocity that vary with time have also been derived

articleTitle: Prediction of Electromagnetic Shadow Zone in Atmospheric Duct
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Electromagnetic shadow zone is an important propagation character which is caused by atmospheric duct. The purpose of this paper is to find a method to predict such shadow zone. Two numerical models are introduced in this paper. The first one is used to predict the top hole in evaporation duct. The other one is to predict the skip zone in surface duct. It is concluded that these two models are effective

articleTitle: The Radar 2-D Imaging Bases on GRECO
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) is a way of radar imaging, but the recognition of this way is not very well. This paper presents a different way of radar 2-D imaging, which bases on GRECO. This paper compares the two ways, and the conclusion is that the new way is better than the ISAR imaging in shape of its recognition, and new way 2-D imaging could be an assistant imaging to the ISAR imaging

articleTitle: Experimental study on electromagnetic radiation effects to an electronic system through ultra-wide band source
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The radiation effect experiment to a complicated electronic system by using of GW ultra-wide band (UWB) radiation source has been carried out. In cases of opening or closing the door of equipment under test (EUT) , the responses of test points on combination No.04 and No.08 of EUT have been measured. The response characteristics of test points on combination No.02 have been tested at different orientations of antenna of EUT. And spectrum analysis has been performed for response waveforms. The results have shown that the response voltage on internal circuits of EUT may reach about 1.6 kV at condition of opening door of EUT when radiated by UWB source with 2.0times104 V/m of field strength (rise time is 0.3 ns and pulse width is 3-4 ns). The maximum response voltage on combination No.02 is about 1.6 kV under condition of optimum coupling of antenna. In this case, some of the electronic components which are sensitive to electromagnetic field may be damaged. The response band width of EUT is about 500 MHz and main frequency point of response is about 70 MHz which are far apart from the working frequency of EUT. So the frequency of the outside electromagnetic field is not the main reason which affects EUT

articleTitle: Rate-Equation-Based VCSEL Thermal Model and Simulation
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, we present a simple thermal model of vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) light-current (LI) characteristics based on the rate equation. The model is apt to implement in conventional SPICE-like circuit simulators, including HSPICE, and used to simulate the key features of VCSEL. The results compare favorably to experimental data from a device reported in the literature

articleTitle: A Centre Controlled strategy for Adaptive Spectrum Access
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Based on the radio frequency spectrum measurement in Beijing, this paper analyzed the traditional spectrum allotment and pointed out the low efficiency can be improved by adaptive spectrum access. Furthermore, a centre controlled strategy of cognitive radio has been provided insight into the benefits and possible implement to cognitive radio design and policy

articleTitle: The Analysis about Targets Near-field Scattering Characteristics under the Influence of Doppler frequency-shift
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Under the influence of Doppler frequency-shift, the theory model about targets near-field bistatic scattering is established with PO method and cell-method depending on SCTE. The formula of bistatic RCS is obtained and it can be degenerated to describe monostatic RCS. Then some curves are presented which are in accordance with the results given by references

articleTitle: Registration of Electrical Current in Physical Vacuum
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: We assume, that vacuum currents flow in conducting thready structures of the physical vacuum (in "fluxes"), isolated from anyone bodies, through which they pass. For measurement of a current density in any environments on its magnetic influence we developed and tested a fammeter - flux ammeter. Density of a vacuum current not sensitive to shielding about 1 mA/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is registered. On a precise minimum of density of a vertical component of vacuum current in a series of consecutive measurements fammeter fixes sunrise to within one minute. The average positive current (directed to the centre of the Earth) usually grows by evening and is minimal at the night, and the negative current is minimal in the afternoon. Vacuum current is not sensitive to shielding but current density minimum fixes sunrise. The vacuum current is very unstable. The new source of the geophysical information may be useful to prediction earthquakes and others catastrophes

articleTitle: Accurate Calculation of Impendence Matrix Elements in Analyzing Transient EMC/EMI Problems of Dielectric Bodies
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, a method of calculation of matrix elements accurately for analyzing transient electromagnetic compatibility and interference (EMC/EMI) problems of homogeneous dielectric bodies using marching on in time (MOT) algorithm is presented. The proposed method calculates the temporal basis function accurately when the integral is singular, instead of using the centroidal points into the temporal basis function commonly

articleTitle: The Algorithm for Locating Ground Faults on Power Distribution Based on Electromagnetic Calculations
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Based on electromagnetic (EM) calculations, the transfer function algorithm is proposed for locating line-to-ground faults on power distribution networks. This paper applies transfer function theory to the location of ground faults on power distribution networks. Transfer function equations are given for single-phase and three-phase distribution lines, with criteria for locating ground faults. Simulations with EMTP show that the criteria, which are based on the frequency, phase and shape characteristics of the transfer function spectrum, effectively locate faults in distribution networks. Since it is valid for power distribution networks with offset lines, and immune to load changes and its parameters can be easily measured, the fault location algorithm can be widely applied to pave distribution networks

articleTitle: Three Coaxial-feed Axial Mode Spherical Helical Antennas
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Characteristics of three coaxial-feed axial mode spherical helical antennas are analyzed by the moment method. The results indicate that gains of the one-arm spherical helical antenna and the hemispherical helical antenna vary acutely in the frequency band and their main beams float from the axial direction when the frequency higher than 1600 MHz. The two-arm hemispherical helical antenna has more than 100% pattern bandwidth and impedance bandwidth, and its gain bandwidth is -93% and the peak gain is 10.7 dB, which shows that it is of great potential value in broadband application

articleTitle: A Calibration Algorithm for Mutual Coupling Errors of Array Sensors Based on the Nonlinear Constraint
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A new calibration approach needing one calibration source is presented to estimate the mutual coupling coefficients of uniform circular array. Firstly, the data collection is done by placing one assistant source in different direction. Then the cost function is present by using the signal subspace vector and noise subspace vector of data covariance matrix. Under the nonlinear constraint, the union DOA estimation of assistant source and the mutual coupling coefficients of uniform circular array are given by iterative operation. The algorithm does not need know the direction of assistant source. Simulations show validity of the algorithm

articleTitle: Study on Ultra-wideband Scattering Characteristics of Targets Based on UPML-FDTD
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The ultra-wideband (UWB) scattering characteristics of targets are computed by the method of FDTD with unsplit-field perfectly matched layer (UPML) boundary condition. The scattering waveform and RCS of targets are presented. The computation results of sphere are compared with the Mie series solutions and both are accorded with well. It proves that the method is very efficient. The ultra-wideband scattering characteristics of targets are valuable to targets identification and stealthy technique

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Typical High-Speed Digital Transmission Channel
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper optimizes the building blocks of a typical high speed digital transmission channel. It demonstrates how the physical parameters that generally considered to be jerkwater greatly affect the performance of high speed transmission at last. We give a few suggestions to increase simulation efficiency and especially to avoid the uncertainly of manufacturing

articleTitle: Effect of electromagnetic pulse exposure on the permeability of blood-testicle barrier in mice
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper study the effect of electromagnetic pulse (EMP) exposure on the permeability of blood-testicle barrier (BTB) in mice. Adult male BALB/c mice were exposed to EMP at 200 kV/m for 200 pulses with 2 seconds interval. The mice were injected with 2% Evans Blue solution through caudal vein at different time point after exposure, and the permeability of BTB was observed by fluorescence microscope. The testis sample for the transmission electron microscopy was prepared at 2h after EMP exposure. The permeability of BTB in mice was observed by using Evans Blue tracer and lanthanum nitrate tracer. After exposure, cloudy Evans Blue was found in the testicle convoluted seminiferous tubule of mice. Lanthanum nitrate was observed not only between testicle spermatogonia near seminiferous tubule wall and sertoli cells, but also between sertoli cells and primary spermatocyte or secondary spermatocyte. However, in control group lanthanum, nitrate was only found in the testicle sertoli cells between seminiferous tubule and near seminiferous tubule wall. EMP exposure could increase the permeability of BTB in the mice

articleTitle: The effect of wild-type p53 on the response of K562 to EMP
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The wild-type p53 is investigated whether it has an effect on apoptosis and cell cycle distribution of K562 cells after EMP irradiation. The K562 cells transfected with wild-type p53 were irradiated by EMP and then cultured for 18h. Apoptosis and cell cycle were detected by FCM. Apoptosis and G1 arrest were induced by p53 transfection. No effect of EMP was detected on cell cycle and apoptosis of K562 cells with different p53 statuses. Exposure to EMP has no effects on K562 cells before and after p53 gene transfection

articleTitle: A Simple Method to Calculate Electric Field Distribution and Characteristic ImpedanceIn ATEM Cell With Thin Metallic EUT
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: ATEM cell is widely used in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) test. When loaded with equipment under test (EUT), the electric field in ATEM cell will be distorted , and the characteristic impedance changed. In this paper, the field distribution and characteristic impedance in ATEM cell loaded with thin metallic EUT is analyzed by a simple method - point matching method. The section of an asymmetric TEM was divided into three regions and potential function is expressed as a Fourier series in each region. The point-matching was used on the interface of these regions to determine coefficients of series. Thus, the characteristic impedance can be calculated and electric field obtained in terms of a potential function

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Line Tower Lightning Surge Impedance Using the Time Domain Electromagnetic Method
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A time domain electromagnetic field approach is proposed to investigate the lightning surge impedance of the full scale UHV tower with grounding system. The model, which is validated by comparing the result to those of other method, can be used to analyze the lightning surge performance of a power line more accurately. Finally, this method is applied to analyze the surge impedance and potential of a real UHV tower

articleTitle: Microstrip Antenna Research at Millimeter Wave Technique Laboratory of NJUST
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This paper gives an overview of the microstrip antenna research carried out at Millimeter Wave Technique Laboratory (MWTL) of Nanjing Univeristy of Science and Technology (NJUST). It describes the development on both the antenna elements and the arrays for different requirements such as high gain, low side lobe level, wide frequency bandwidth, equal beamwidth in both principal planes, wide angle coverage pattern, low cross polarization, pattern diversity array, circular polarization array and specific function array needed in monopulse radar. In addition to the structure, the design approaches and tools are briefly introduced. The performance of adaptive nulling under the presence of mutual coupling in digital beamforming microstrip antenna array is discussed as well.

articleTitle: The Influence of Interphase Interference to The Sampling Method Based on Voltage-dividing Capacitor
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Capacitive equipments are very important in our power system. So on-line monitoring of power equipments becomes necessary. In the on-line monitoring system, voltage-dividing capacitor often take place the role of sampling unit. But interphase interference can influence the accuracy of detection. In this paper, we introduce the principle of sampling based on voltage-dividing capacitor. And set up the model of interphase interference. Finally, the analysis of interphase interference is processed, the result of simulation prove the sampling method of voltage-dividing capacitor is accurately

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Damage Effects of Integrated Circuits Stressed with ESD EMP
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Several RC (resistance and capacitance) combinations were adopted in ESS-AX200 ESD simulator to generate different ESD pulses. And the pulses were injected into an integrated circuit. The damage effects of the integrated circuit stressed with these pulses were investigated. Results showed that the current passing through the device will increase when the discharge voltage increases. The relationship between the peak energy absorbed by the IC chip and the discharge voltage can be modeled as the bell-shaped Gaussian function. The failure thresholds of the IC were the same order of magnitude and were found to vary by less than a factor of two

articleTitle: Effects of exposure to ultra-wide band on anti lipid peroxidation indication in the heart and lungs of rats
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The effects of exposure to ultra-wide band (UWB) on aerobic metabolism and the activity in the heart and the lung of rats are investigated. TBA colorimetric methods were used to determine the changes in SOD activity and the content of MDA in the heart and the lung of rats after the rats were exposed to a certain dose of UWB. The results showed that, compared with control group, the activity of SOD in the heart was significantly reduced at 72 hours after the rats were exposed to 100 k pulses (P<0.01). The activity of SOD in the heart was significantly decreased at 12, 24 and 48 hours after the rats were exposed to 400 k pulses (P<0.01), whereas the activity of SOD in the lung was obviously increased at 24 hours after exposure compared with that of the control group (P<0.01). Compared with control group, the content of MDA in the heart was significantly reduced at 48 and 72 hours after exposure to 100 k pulses. The content of MDA in the lung was increased significantly at 24 hours after exposure to 100 k pulses. After exposure to UWB, the activity of SOD in the heart was reduced, but that was activated in the lung, which would in turn affect the content of MDA simultaneously

articleTitle: Design of a New Kind of Electromagnetic Sensitivity System
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, a new scheme of circuits to an electromagnetic sensitivity system is designed. The system is to be used in stimulant training equipments. Through the test of experiments, it can be seen that the results of experiments agree with the theory, so the scheme is reliable and desirable. The maximum distance of measuring is 150 cm. The measuring error of distance is less than 1.5 cm and the measuring error of angle is less than 1.6deg, thus the circuits are helpful to the research of many kinds of position and orientation tracking system

articleTitle: Measurement of the Amplitude and Phase of FM Noise Currents on a Personal Computer Chassis
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: IT equipment mostly uses dithered clocks, radiating FM noise especially in the frequency range above 1 GHz. Investigations are carried out to measure the noise source current flows on a PC chassis. Since network analyzers are useless for measurement of FM noises, a six-port junction is developed and used with a pair of loop antennas. This instrument can display current flows of PC harmonic noises

articleTitle: Efficiency of cable lightning protection by wire
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: An existing method of calculation of protective wires shielding factor is not accurate, as it takes into account only inductance of cable and protective wires without of active resistance. In fact at the front of wave the current of a lightning is allocated between a cable and a protective wire mainly in inverse proportion to inductive resistance, on decay of a wave it is divided in inverse proportion to their active resistance. There are some corrections to a method that is in use, which are discussed in this paper

articleTitle: The Simulation Study of Radar Network Using RCS Data
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Radar targets characteristic database is created by creating the electromagnetic mesh model of targets, then calculating the RCS of the angles and frequencies, last storing the data in a database. The radar network simulation system, composed of center computer, radar targets characteristic database, and several radars, is established. During the course of simulation, the aircraft flies according to certain track, the radars calculate a disperse traces by the RCS from database according to the position, angles toward to the aircraft and threshold of radar, update the dot traces to the center computer; the center computer fuses the tracks from radars to reproduce the fly trace. The simulation results indicate that radar network using the radar target characteristic database increases the finding probability of radar greatly

articleTitle: Combining Method of Graphic Electromagnetic Computing to Design Shaped-beam Antenna With Single Feeding Source
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The method of combining GRECO (Graphical Electromagnetic Computing) to design shaped-beam reflect antenna containing single feeding source is first proposed. Shaped-beam reflect antenna in random shape is able to be designed easily by using NURBS (Non-uniform Rational Basic Spline), and the shape of a little part is able to be changed by changing the controlling points, so the phase of the reflect antenna is easily to be controlled to reach the best result. The reflect antenna is able to be divided into fragmentary parts automatically. By setting the fitting light model and light sources, the normal of the surface of the antenna is able to be gained in the case of not knowing the expression of the reflect antenna.

articleTitle: MLFMA based on Improved Electric Field Integral Equation (IEFIE)
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) based on an improved electric field integral equation (IEFIE) is developed to achieve fast solution of electromagnetic scattering from 3D open structures. The present method attains much faster convergence than traditional EFIE. And, a reasonable accuracy is also achieved in a few iterations. Numerical results demonstrate the validity and efficiency of the present method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Coupling Field Inside a Rectangular Shielded Enclosure with an Aperture
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method was used to study the plane wave coupling into a rectangular shielded enclosure through a aperture, and the theoretical prediction agree with the measured characteristics well. Results show that: 1) if the wave sources travel vertically to the aperture, the coupling field inside the cavity is mainly composed of different modes resonance fields; and 2) if the wave sources travel along the direction parallel with the aperture, the coupling field is the sum of the lower-frequency components with the sources' characteristics and the higher-frequency resonance fields of the cavity

articleTitle: RF Performance Test Analysis of 3G UE
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The demodulation performance test of receiver is to verify the demodulation quality of receiver under channel conditions with noise, fading, handover, transmit diversity and so on. It is an important factor to influence the Quality of Service(QoS). In this paper the RF performance of WCDMA and TD-SCDMA UE is analyzed. In addition, the common test conditions and acceptable uncertainty are also comparatively analyzed, and give some advice to the TD-SCDMA test specification.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Investigation on the coupling scattering model of a static conducting plate above the time-varying sea surface
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Taking the advantage of a newly developed technique that uses the reciprocity theorem, the difficulty in formulating the scattered interaction between time-varying sea surface and a conducting plate is reduced. Meanwhile, a model is formulated for Doppler spectral shift of the coupling field, and is compared with the results simulated with the scattering field obtained in this work

articleTitle: ESD Immunity Test and Several Improvements for Digital Electronic Dictionary
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Electronic devices are getting more and more sensitive to the electro-static discharge (ESD) because of their smaller size and higher frequency. An electronic dictionary device studied here has failed in the ESD immunity test according to the IEC61000-4-2 standard. Many factors which could impact on the ESD immunity performance of the device are investigated in the test and some suggestions are also given in this paper for improving its performance. The improving suggestions are listed and analyzed combining the device in detail in this paper: 1) improving the ESD immunity performance of the dictionary's PCB; 2) changing the outer package material for the dictionary, protecting the LED; and 3) building a complete ESD test system. The device has gained a significant improvement on the ESD immunity by using merely part of our suggestions. We hope that this could be a reference to the manufactures of similar devices as well

articleTitle: Time-Domain Physical-Optics Method for Transient Scattering Analysis
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The time-domain physical-optical (TD-PO) approximation is derived from the frequency-domain physical-optical expression by the inverse Fourier transformation. The transient scattering and RCS in a wide band of metal sphere and cube are computed. Numerical results show that TD-PO method requires relatively small amounts of computer memory and CPU time. It is an efficient algorithm for analyzing the wide band characteristic of electrically large objects

articleTitle: A mathematical modeling and analysis of plasma antenna
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: A basic mathematical model of the plasma antenna is developed and using the boundary conditions, characteristic parameters and current distribution of the plasma antenna are obtained. Finally, the radiation pattern of dipole is shown

articleTitle: Nontrivial Translational Fabrication Simulation For Phenomenal Polarizer Bistable Liquid Crystal Display
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The problems of these two technologies have caused more and more product designers to turn to liquid crystal (LC) displays, which have consequently experienced phenomenal growth. The success of liquid crystal displays has fostered continued development, to the point where full-color video displays have been realized which can rival. Details of the lens structure and of the devices fabrication and performance are described, simulation using the Jones matrix method. Director n can change from point to point and in general a function of space. The transition can be approached by changing the impurity concentration or, indirectly, by tuning the temperature since the pinning strengths of the random and crystal potential have in general a different temperature dependence. Light from conventional light source or laser is passed through a polarizer and then incident on the specimen. The resist profile simulation is carried out using the combined data thus obtained. The nematic liquid crystal is clear only when a long range order exists, in the whole medium. At the nematic-isotropic, transition temperature,the medium becomes isotropic and looks clear and transparent

articleTitle: The HEMP coupling effect of protective engineering's entrance
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, four coupling effect models of protective engineering's entrance are set up by using FDTD method and modified generalized total-field/scattered-field boundary. HEMP coupling effect of shielding gate and thin-slot on shielding gate are studied, and some valuable conclusions are obtained

articleTitle: ADI-FDTD Method for Transformed Maxwell's Equations
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The Crank-Nicolson method is applied to the field transformed Maxwell's equations to derive an ADI FDTD scheme. The proposed method significantly reduces the limitation on time-step size and the computational domain to only one period of the structure. Using the von Neumann technique, the numerical stability of the proposed method was studied

articleTitle: Analysis of EM Scattering by Electrically Large Coated Object
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The high-frequency method in conjunction with impedance boundary condition is one of effective tools in analyze the far or near field of EM scattering by electrically large coated object. The far field RCS of coated plate calculated in the paper shows agreement with experimental results , and the differences between near field RCS and the far field RCS concludes that the near field scattering must be taken into account while using coating stealthy technology for electrically large object. In addition, the RCS of XX ship coated with four kinds of RAM is given in the paper

articleTitle: Test Research on UWB Effects and Mechanism of Radio Fuze
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: This research indicates that the fuze's EED itself and the nonworking status fuze are safe in the radiation of UWB. Because of the SCR (silicon controlled rectifier) in fuze mistakenly turning from off status to on status, the fuzes under test all explode when the peak-peak E-field of the UWB is 106 kV/m

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Carrier Frequency in Doppler Simulator
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The design process of carrier frequency in Doppler simulator is summarized in this paper. Because two phase-related and dispersion-fixed frequencies are demanded in the system, traditional realization methods are pretty complicated, the chip SI4133 is used in this system to realize the function and generate two frequencies as 800 MHz and 840 MHz, the phase noises are both -89 dBc/Hz/10 KHz, which satisfies the requirement of project well

articleTitle: Design of a 2.1GHz GaAs low noise amplifier for CDMA RF front end
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: On discussing GaAs process RF LNA performance of gain, unconditionally stability, noise figure, the design with EMC analysis of a 2.1 GHz low noise amplifier (LNA) implemented with GaAs technology is presented here. Simulation results show this LNA works well centered at 2.1 GHz frequency, with a 16 dB forward power gain (S21) and a noise figure (NF) less than 0.8 dB, also unconditionally stability

articleTitle: Extracting the Poles of Transient Responses from the Aperture Coupling
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The electromagnetic pulse transient response of the later-time can be approximated as the sum of damped complex exponentials. In this paper, extraction of the poles and their corresponding residues of the transient response from the aperture coupling by using the matrix pencil algorithm is presented and a brief discussion is given on influence for different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) on extracted parameters. The numerical calculation and the reconstruction waveforms from the measured data indicate that the proposed algorithm is suitable for the SNR is higher than 4.45 dB signal

articleTitle: Model for Calculating the Coupling between Spatial EM Wave and Circuits
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: An efficient coupling model for general circuit systems is presented in this paper. Based on BLT equations and microwave network theory, the coupling voltage on any sub-circuit port, caused by incident electromagnetic wave, can be calculated easily with this model. It is helpful for the future EMI estimation of electric systems.

articleTitle: Lost 2 Million RMB due to The Voltage Dip for 70 ms
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: One real example illustrates that the power quality interrupt the engineering manufacturing seriously. The correspondent voltage compensation devices are urgent required and the indirect harm of the lightning stroke needs further studied. Many kinds of EMC problems in power system should be paid attention to

articleTitle: The Research of the Monitoring System of Electromagnetic Radiation (40Hz~40GHz) In Bei Jing Olympic Gymnasium
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: At present, the monitoring system of 40Hz~26GHz electromagnetic radiation has been accomplished[5], basing on which, the author puts up the research of the monitoring system of electromagnetic radiation (40Hz~40GHz). The article emphatically introduces the software control flow, and presents parts of test results.

articleTitle: Introduction to the Next-Generation Network And Related Compatibility
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Some new results of ITU-T on next-generation network are introduced. The target environment of NGN is discussed. The important impact of NGN is also described

articleTitle: Effects of EMP on the Hematological Parameters and Bone Marrow Cells of Mice
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: To evaluate the possible effects of EMP on blood system, blood samples and bone marrow cells of male BALB/c mice were collected for hematology determinations , CFU-GM colony assay, [Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>]i assessment and cell cycle measurement. Our results indicate that EMP can affect some parameters of blood system

articleTitle: The Calculation of The Electric and The Magnetic Field in The Organism under The Electromagnetism Radiation
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Original electricity magnetic field of organism itself, which's combined with external electricity magnetic field, can produce new electricity and magnetic field under electromagnetism radiation. Generally speaking, traditional method used to add these two electricity and magnetic fields in vector dimension. However, this method failed when analyzing the original and external one that it absorbs. In this essay, the new electromagnetism is put into the Maxwell equation and Greene function so as to calculate both electric and magnetic field on some point of the organism. Through the calculation, echo and transmission are taken into account when electromagnetic wave comes into the organism, so the result is close to the real value

articleTitle: Cell Gap Measurement for Nucleation Transmitted For Bistable Liquid Crystal
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Summary form only given. The method underlying this development is formulated in terms of multiple-scattering theory with the real-space representation. When the light passes through the TN medium number of times. Long range heteronuclear coupling constants provide valuable information for the stereochemical and conformational analysis of biologically active natural products. The purpose of this project is to provide the electrochemical industry with solutions to some fundamental problems whose understanding is of importance in the design of cells with a liquid electrolyte. In such cells, transport of ionic species is due to three different mechanisms - convection, migration (due to the electric field)

articleTitle: Satellite Communication Equipments Reliability and Lightning Surge Measurement Results
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: Equipments damage cause by lightning strike was been a hot topic for a quite long ago especially in tropical region. Due to certain component sensitivity level was decreased, so that components easily failed. From satellite equipments reliability calculation shows that the system facing a wear out zone where the hazard rate is increasing. So the appropriate protection level for these equipments to survive during lightning strike would be a challenge. However in this tropical country the study on statistical data for lightning occurrence probability and standardization is fewer even though they experiences on high lightning activities of 200-240 thunderstorm days/year. This paper present the measurement results of the lightning induce surges on the AC mains connected to the satellite equipments. Observation shows that the total surges been recorded was 26 sets on duration of seven months during 11 thunderstorm days. The measurement was done at fours location remote suburban area. The large surges was recorded as 300 A. And estimated value of occurrence probability gives the ratio of 4.4 times higher than the Japan AC mains measurement result. The wave shape of induce surge is 10.2/37.3 mus. The rise time is 10.2 mus and time to half value is 37.3 mus was observed. This waveform was almost shows a good agreement of 8/20 mus current waveform on IEEE testing waveform. Calculated specific energy is 6.22times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>s. As a result the surge protection level should considering a higher level than other country

articleTitle: Effects of EMP on Mouse Embryonic Limb Bud Cells
publicationTitle: The 2006 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics
abstract: The effect of EMP on mouse embryonic limb bud cells is observed. Mouse embryonic limb bud cells were exposed to EMP during cultures. Neutral red uptake bioassay and alcian blue uptake bioassay were used to observe the proliferation and differentiation of the cells respectively.
